description: This file defines the 'Warehouse' class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, including its interfaces, methods, constructors, destructors, and nested classes. It sets up the plugin's structure, external dependencies, and interface mappings, primarily serving as a header declaration for a hardware management plugin with optional front panel LED controls.
